mapper.select: SELECT principal_type, principal_id, COUNT(*)::integer AS violation_count, COUNT(DISTINCT resource_ref)::integer AS distinct_resource_count FROM audit_event WHERE occurred_at > CAST(#{windowEnd} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - (#{windowSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second') AND occurred_at <= #{windowEnd} AND principal_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'PARTNER') AND principal_id IS NOT NULL AND result = 'DENIED' AND reason_code = 'OBJECT_ACCESS_DENIED' AND action IN ('ACCOUNT_READ', 'TRANSACTION_READ', 'GRANT_CREATE', 'GRANT_REVOKE') AND resource_ref IS NOT NULL GROUP BY principal_type, principal_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT resource_ref) >= 3 ORDER BY principal_type, principal_id

INSERT INTO detection_state AS state (rule_id, principal_type, principal_id, last_alert_at, last_window_end) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{principalType}, #{principalId}, clock_timestamp(), #{windowEnd}) ON CONFLICT (rule_id, principal_type, principal_id) DO UPDATE SET last_alert_at = clock_timestamp(), last_window_end = EXCLUDED.last_window_end WHERE state.last_alert_at <= clock_timestamp() - (#{cooldownSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second') AND EXCLUDED.last_window_end >= state.last_alert_at + (#{cooldownSeconds} * INTERVAL '1 second') AND state.last_window_end < EXCLUDED.last_window_end RETURNING last_alert_at
